name: FRIDAY
author: Project FRIDAY
description: Live FRIDAY status and one deliberate command surface in a native Omarchy bar widget: daemon status, current activity, last goal outcome, voice, host telemetry, and an explicit goal entry (R5-1-3). It observes via the genuine file-backed state and acts only on an explicit user GO.

barWidget.description: A calm FRIDAY widget: glanceable status dot + rich panel reflecting the daemon's state.json, plus a deliberate goal-command surface. Opening the panel sends nothing; a goal runs only when the user presses GO (or sends via the friday.shell IPC target).

schema.label: Path to state.json (empty = default ~/.local/state/friday/state.json)
schema.description: Override the daemon state file this widget watches.

schema.label: friday-ctl command
schema.description: The audited CLI the widget invokes to run a goal. Must be on PATH.

schema.label: Daemon listen address
schema.description: Loopback address friday-ctl connects to (a non-default addr is passed through).
